subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

Each of the students **have** a book.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "**Each of the students**," which is a singular subject.
 
• The verb must agree with the singular subject, so the correct verb is "**has**" and not "**have**."
 
• The original sentence incorrectly uses the plural verb "**have**," which does not match the singular subject "**Each**."
 
• Thus, replacing "**have**" with "**has**" ensures subject-verb agreement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Each of the students **has** a book."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "had" would imply past tense, which is not suitable here as the sentence refers to the present.
 
• **Option 3:** "gets" is incorrect because it does not fit the structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4:** "is having" is incorrect as it suggests a continuous action, which does not align with the context.
